- I then edit and refine these ideas to ensure they are relevant, interesting, and acceptable for generating high quality reports.
- I also use a template to ensure that the topic ideas are structured and organized in a consistent manner.
- I then feed these topic ideas into a Claude Project that specializes in building high quality reports based on the topic ideas.

- Then using the information form your research to generate a list of the most relevant and interesting KEY words.
